title: 30-Day Plank Challenge
description: Hold a 2-minute plank every day for 30 days. Each day is worth 1 point, a missed day is worth nothing. Every 10th day you can hold 3 minutes instead, for 2 points total. After a miss you can hold 30 extra seconds (worth +0.5 extra) to catch up — until you're back on pace.

title: 30-Day Plank Max Challenge
description: Plank once a day for 30 days and hold as long as you can. The first 2 minutes are worth 1 point, and every extra 30 seconds earns +0.5 more — up to 9 points for a 10-minute hold. Your best hold of the day counts.
